title: Simplify standalone AL code review skill
summary: The standalone AL code review skill is renamed from bcquality-al-review to al-code-review, with its SKILL.md simplified to a thin adapter that delegates to internal Entry and coordinator components. Plugin manifests and version are updated accordingly.
key_points: Skill renamed from bcquality-al-review to al-code-review to avoid collision with BC-ALAgents al-review skill
Host-facing SKILL.md reduced to a thin adapter translating caller goals to Entry's task context
Plugin manifests point to canonical skills/ directory with version bumped to 0.2.0
New documentation clarifies the distinction between host adapter, Entry, internal coordinator, and domain leaves
Validator extended to enforce host-skill naming and required frontmatter
